taskings.situation: The 1st Cavalry Division Artillery provides support to the IIIAC Change of Responsibility ceremony at Fort Hood, TX.

execution.concept_of_operations: 1st Cavalry Division provides support for the IIIAC Change of Responsibility.

items.text: Provide salute battery with enough ammunition to support COR ceremony.
**Honor Guard:** Provide Honor Guard for cake cutting detail.
Provide full Band for the COR Ceremony.

coordinating_instructions.text: Units are required to be at the staging area NLT 0815.
Inclement weather rehearsal will be conducted at III Armored Corps East Atrium TBD.

signal.text: The POC for this order is CPT Adam Isakson at adam.j.isakson.mil@army.mil.

taskings.situation: SMRC is experiencing civilian staffing shortages.

execution.concept_of_operations: 1st Cavalry Division rapidly adapts to medical staffing constraints.

items.text: Realign Separation/ETS physical workflows from SMRC to respective BN PAs.

coordinating_instructions.text: Do not send Soldiers for walk-in/uncoordinated physicals.

signal.text: The Primary POC is 2LT Woojin Lee at woojin.lee13.mil@army.mil.
